pay_experience_credit_indistrict_013.answer: discussed_unclear - Document does not distinguish in-district experience; applies a uniform rule to all prior teaching experience (1:1 credit for up to 10 years, 1:2 thereafter).
pay_experience_credit_indistrict_013.evidence: Experience earned in the ten (10) year period prior to employment shall be credited at the rate of one (1) year of credit for each year of teaching experience... Beyond Ten (10) Years: Experience earned before the ten-year period prior to employment shall be credited at the rate of one (1) year of credit for each two full years of teaching experience.

pay_experience_credit_military_public_01.answer: yes - Military service credited up to 4 years if teacher training/MN requirements met before service. Peace Corps credited same rate as teaching experience.
pay_experience_credit_military_public_01.evidence: Military service prior to hiring shall be credited in lieu of teaching experience if the teacher completed her/his teacher training and met the Minnesota requirements for teaching before entering military service. The total amount of military service for which credit will be given shall not exceed four (4) years. Teaching experience in the Peace Corps shall be given credit at the same rate as other teaching experience.
pay_experience_credit_military_public_01.coder_notes: Removed unquoted detail '(>=8 months counts as full year)' to ensure answer strictly aligns with provided evidence.

pay_national_board_017.answer: yes - advances one (1) lane on the teacher salary schedule; eligible for a $1,000 stipend for NBPTS coach/staff developer/demonstration teacher roles
pay_national_board_017.evidence: Any Minneapolis Public School professionally licensed teacher who achieves the National Board for Professional Teacher Standards' (NBPTS) National Board Certification (NBC) will advance one (1) lane on the teacher salary schedule. ... eligible for a $1,000 stipend.
